comparison.objective: Set and lock a telescoping pole to length versus tune and lock a shock absorber for dynamic response.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual counter-twist, axial extension to a mark, retwist, and load test versus hex-key setscrew work, fine collar rotation, repeated impacts, and relocking.
comparison.success_condition: Pole within 10 mm of mark and shortening under 2 mm at 50 N versus two safe stops within 12 mm stroke and a post-lock witness test.
comparison.reason: This is the closest record: both adjust, relock, and verify retention under load. The candidate nevertheless tests a distinct ability—iterative damping calibration from dynamic carriage response plus separate setscrew retention—rather than length setting by coaxial twist. Candidate drift and witness-torque thresholds must still be declared.
